name: Peracense (Spain)
description: A white hexagonal panel at the hoist bearing a castle between two lions, the field red with a stripe of yellow and red bars edged yellow and a chevron of the bars of Aragon.
history: Municipal flag of Peracense; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: hexagonal panel at the hoist bearing a castle between two lions
castle with a plant above between two lions
chevron of yellow and red bars pointing to the hoist
